title: stroke-mi-period-detection-benchmark: analysis code and results for benchmarking motor-imagery period detection in stroke EEG across four public datasets
description: Analysis code, per-patient result files, statistical families, single-source number tables and figures for the paper 'Benchmarking motor-imagery period detection in stroke EEG across four public datasets: fixed rules, trained classifiers, calibration budgets and a specificity audit' (Yao Xie and Lirui Sun, University of Science and Technology of China). The four public datasets are not redistributed; download instructions are in data/README.md.
